binding_requirements.description: the exact intended reference recording, established by owner declaration and structural fit, never by title alone
binding_requirements.edition_constraint: Children (Dream Version), full-length, approximately 7:06, complete through the composed ending and coda; track 1 of the official Robert Miles Bandcamp Dreamland digital edition; digital lossless download; catalog number not assigned or not published for this digital edition. Excluded: Dream Radio Edit, Radio Edit, Eat Me Edit, Message Version, Original Version or Mix, Guitar Mix, Dream Club Version, streaming captures, user edits and shortened compilations. A musically similar version with a different mix, intro, outro, edit or mastering is a control candidate, not the answer key.

edition_declaration.form_requirement: complete arrangement through the composed ending and coda
edition_declaration.not_a_lineage_claim: This does not assert the piano transcription was derived from the Dream Version. The score-side proof establishes it was derived from no recording at all.
edition_declaration.rationale: Prospective, not recovered. The score branch never opened a recording, so no historically intended edition exists to trace. The full-length Dream Version is chosen because it preserves enough form to test 69 printed measures expanding to 105 performed, and carries an extended arrangement and composed ending against which tempo, repetition, section alignment, orchestration and coda behaviour can be evaluated. A four-minute radio edit would collapse the structural material this lane exists to study, and the Original, Message and Guitar variants are distinct arrangements rather than alternate containers of one neutral answer key.
edition_declaration.selected_release_surface: official Robert Miles Bandcamp Dreamland download, track 1
edition_declaration.sheet_tempo_excluded_from_selection: The 130 bpm marking is score-branch evidence read off page 1 and takes no part in version selection.

edition_finding.answer: none; the score branch never opened a recording
edition_finding.consequence: The edition cannot be recovered by tracing the score, and the absence is structural rather than a gap in the record: independence is what makes the cross-modal convergence claim mean anything. The intended edition must therefore be declared by the owner as a commission decision and then confirmed by structural fit against the score's form -- 69 printed measures expanding to 105 performed, the repeat and D.S. al Coda navigation, section boundaries, ending behaviour and tempo-map compatibility.
evidence: the score artifact is a 4-page third-party piano transcription, not an edition-linked publication
the printed tempo of 130 bpm was read off page 1 with a bounding box, so it is the sheet's marking rather than a measurement of any recording
docs/CHILDREN_BUFFALO_GATE.md requires branch independence: a score-derived artifact in the audio ledger is refused

structural_fit_criteria.note: The acquired object is a declared answer-key CANDIDATE. Promotion to answer_key requires every criterion below to hold.
